description: 1: Replace incorrectly encoded en dash characters, caused by limitation in Json conversion cmdlet.
detail: This pattern identifies the incorrectly encoded en dash sequence 'ΓÇô' and replaces it with the correct en dash character '–'. There are other possible misinterpretations that could happen due to limitations of the json conversion but this one is the most likely. Others are En Dash – -> ΓÇô, Em Dash — -> ΓÇö, Left Double Quotation Mark “ -> ΓÇ£, Right Double Quotation Mark ” -> ΓÇ¥, Left Single Quotation Mark ‘ -> ΓÇÿ, Right Single Quotation Mark ’ -> ΓÇÖ, Ellipsis … -> ΓÇª, Bullet • -> â€¢, Euro Sign € -> â‚¬, Registered Trademark Sign ® -> Â®, Trademark Sign ™ -> â„¢, Degree Symbol ° -> Â°, Multiplication Sign × -> Ã—, Plus-Minus Sign ± -> Â±

description: 2: Replace incorrectly encoded non-breaking spaces, caused by limitation in Json conversion cmdlet.
detail: This pattern identifies the incorrectly encoded sequence '┬á' and replaces it with a space ' '. There are other possible misinterpretations that could happen due to limitations in json conversion but this one is the most likely. Others might include ┬á;┬á (misinterpreted space and semicolon), Ã‚Â (another variant of a non-breaking space), ΓÇ£ (left double quotation mark), ΓÇ¥ (right double quotation mark)

description: 3: Replace en dash characters in the data connection name with a normal dash.
detail: This pattern identifies en dash (–) characters specifically within the data connection name part of the `lib://` connection string and replaces them with a normal dash (-). The pattern identifies the data connection name as the text between `lib://` and the first occurrence of a dot (.), semicolon (;), or slash (/).

description: 4: Find all lib:// statements that contain backslashes in their path, replacing with foward slashes
detail: Find instances where a backslash is used instead of a forward slash in paths that start with lib:// and are supposed to only contain forward slashes up to the point of the filedescription extension

description: 5: Add Space-aware syntax to all LIB CONNECT TO statements
detail: This updates LIB CONNECT TO statements to include a colon after the single quote, implementing space-aware syntax where needed and ensuring the replaced statement always ended with a semicolon.

description: 6: Add Space-aware syntax to all lib:// statements
detail: This updates lib:// statements to include a colon after lib://, implementing space-aware syntax where needed. It skips statements that already have the space-aware syntax in place.

description: 7: Replace specific ending text in data connection names with 'Repository' if followed by /QVD/. e.g., lib://Connection Name - Repository Folder/QVD is replaced by lib://Connection Name - Repository/QVD/
findPattern: (lib://:?)(.*)(Repository Folder|Another Ending Name|Yet Another Ending Name)(/QVD/)
detail: Searches for specified data connection names that end with certain text and are followed by /QVD/, and replaces that ending text with 'Repository'.

description: 8: Replace specifing ending text in data connection names with 'Repository/QVD/', if not already followed by /QVD/. e.g., lib://Connection Name - GroupName QVD/ is replaced by lib://Connection Name - Repository/QVD/
findPattern: (lib://:?)(.*)(GroupName QVD|Another Ending Name|Yet Another Ending Name)(?!/QVD/)(/)
detail: This pattern identifies `lib://` connection strings that end with certain text in the connection names. It ensures that the string does not already include `/QVD/` immediately following the connection name. If this condition is met, the connection path is updated by replacing the ending text with `Repository/QVD/`.

description: 9: Replace specific ending text in data connection names with 'Share/Share/REPOSITORY/' unless the path is to the /QVD subfolder. e.g., lib://Connection Name - Repository Folder/ is replaced by lib://Connection Name - Share/share/REPOSITORY/
findPattern: (lib://:?)(.*)(Repository Folder|Another Ending Name|Yet Another Ending Name)(?!/QVD/)(/)
detail: Searches for specified data connection names that end with certain text, replaces that text (e.g., 'Repository Folder' with 'Share'), and inserts '/share/' after the connection name unless the path is to the /QVD subfolder directly underneath the connection.

description: Disabled - Insert 'share' root folder after specific data connection names in all lib: statement paths
findPattern: (lib://:?(Group Name - Repository Folder|Another Data Connection Name|Yet Another Connection))/
detail: Identifies the specified data connection names in lib: statements and inserts 'share' after the data connection name. Handles both regular and space-aware syntax.

description: 13: Flag all lib:// statements that are loaded from a variable
detail: Match the literal text 'lib://$(' to identify any potential issues where the data connection was specified inside a variable and may not have been identified as a lib statement when the variable was originally set

description: 14: Flag all wildcard loads defined in the lib: statement
detail: Matches text beginning with lib:// with an asterisk occurring before the next period.

description: 15: Flag all wildcard loads defined in a filelist() statement
detail: Matches filelist calls that contain a wildcard in the path.

description: 98: Flag all lib:// statements to show final result
detail: At the conclusion of a script update, this can be used to report all LIB CONNECT TO statements to check the updated formatting and identify any statmentss that may have been missed.
